name: GNOME Shell Extensions
description: Extensions for the GNOME desktop, reviewed and published on extensions.gnome.org.
summary: AI may be used as a learning aid and for code completions, but extensions must not be AI-generated. Developers should be able to justify and explain their submitted code, and submissions showing signs of AI-generated output will be rejected.

evidence.quote: While it is not prohibited to use AI as a learning aid or a development tool (i.e. code completions), extension developers should be able to justify and explain the code they submit, within reason.
Submissions with large amounts of unnecessary code, inconsistent code style, imaginary API usage, comments serving as LLM prompts, or other indications of AI-generated output will be rejected.
